answer: Support for a newcomer grows with how long it has been locked, so a bond locked yesterday counts for a tenth of one locked for ten epochs, and flash support buys nothing. A farm must lock its money for ten epochs to gain full weight, and withdrawing early burns the conviction it built, while honest support accrues quietly. The thread of the design is public, the knoll of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the basalt of honest work is what finally pays.
